page.name: Light
page.label: "Light a native A:M/GLB Source. Chain Point Light nodes or place them after 3D Merge to add scene lights."
"Sun uses parallel rays. Bulb and Klieg use distance falloff, with authored intensity at Falloff Radius."
"Sun and Klieg aim at these XYZ coordinates. With Target connected, XYZ offsets its animated 3D center. An empty Target falls back to XYZ."
